objective: Measure the current 100-card context deck and 50-card board-event deck through mutable legacy core actions, including actual bankruptcy/liquidation and event targeting.

configuration.rng: mulberry32-style deterministic generator; factory shuffle draw order retained

contextResults.method: 10,000 (or requested count) independent factory-shuffled decks; each of 100 cards is applied with core.applyAction(nextTurn), invoking real drawContext, bankruptCompanies, marketImpacts, and notices.

initialPortfolio.purpose: stress exposure only; not representative of a playable fund

boardEventResults.method: Each observation uses core.applyAction(roll) on the first reachable event cell with a controlled die result; only the first Math.random call is overridden, and seeded ordinary random draws choose target zone/company. The engine owns draw, discard, reshuffle, and effect execution.

repeatedTargets.rule: Cooldown excludes four recent global company IDs only when another eligible candidate exists in the selected zone; selection remains zone-first.
